name: Jiangnan Mould & Plastic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangnan Mould & Plastic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of automotive decorative parts in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Automotive Interiors, Real Estate, Hospitals, and Castings. The company offers automotive exterior and interior components, such as front and rear bumper, door sill, front and rear fender, and radiator grille assemblies; plastic tailgates; body side moldings; and interior /exterior electroplated parts, including electroplated grilles, fog light cover assemblies, body trim strips, and logos.
